scope: Images identify hardware families or explicitly labelled components; benchmark evaluations themselves run in simulation. No simulator screenshot is used as gallery art.
rights: Third-party image rights remain with their respective owners. Public availability and source attribution do not grant a redistribution license. Review image permissions before public deployment.
processing: Native transparent product images are used where available. Other selected images were background-extracted with the built-in imagegen tool; those are AI-edited derivatives, not untouched source photographs. Model identity was checked against each reference.

images.prompt: Create a faithful transparent-background cutout from the provided Wuji Hand product image. This is an image editing/extraction task, not robot design. Preserve the exact hand silhouette, finger count, joint geometry, silver metal finish, black palm, blue joint highlights and pose of the reference. Remove only the empty surrounding canvas. Center the complete hand on a tightly framed portrait canvas with 4% transparent margin, no cropping of fingertips or wrist. True transparent alpha, no background, no floor, no labels, no added parts or simulated scene. Do not invent a robot arm.

Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: official robot image for a research project page. Edit target: supplied official image. Extract the two white ARX X5 robot arms, grippers and their black shared supporting mount. Remove background and floor/table around the base. Keep exact geometry, pose, wiring, materials and manufacturer marks. Output tightly framed actual transparent PNG, retaining original photographic/product-image content and proportions. No added text, no checkerboard.
